messages.author: e52b48f39d670ebd
messages.subject: setting defaults from session$clientData$url_search
parts:
Hi,

I am have a simple shiny app (say http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#hello-shiny with a numeric input). It works well.

I then wanted to pass the number of observations from client data.. So in my server.R, I did -

query <- parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)
obs <- ifelse(!is.null(query$obs), query$obs, input$obs)


Now if I pass a value, it will open the app with that as the parameter. However, this will ignore any value of the input control in the future.

Ideally, what I want is that it fills the initial value, but then unsets it so that the user is able to control the parameters from the slider on the app.

How would I go about doing that?

Thanks,

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: setting defaults from session$clientData$url_search
parts: Why not use query$obs as the initial value for input$obs?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: setting defaults from session$clientData$url_search
parts:
Not sure what you mean by 'next iteration' but ...

query <- NULL

but then the URL would still set query to a value again. Perhaps you could add an if statement somewhere to avoid using query when input$obs was changed.

if(!is.null(input$obs) & !is.null(query$obs) & input$obs != query$obs) query <- NULL

If that doesn't work please share your code so we can take a look (e.g., as a gist on github)
